text:
Priya: quick one — I've pushed an update to the private setup wizard network probe step. Mockups + copy in the drive: /designs/onprem/probe-retry-v2. Looking for quick UX + a11y reads before i hand to eng.
Devon: on it. main thing i care about: make the retry affordance feel like a quick check, not a full re-run that takes 2 mins. maybe show 'Quick recheck' vs 'Full diagnostic'. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
Alan: +1. Also we should surface the reason in plain english first, then the raw probe result under a "more details" toggle. non-expert customers get confused by stack traces.
Sam: question about support handoff — if customer clicks "Send diagnostic to support" what do we include? need to mask any private IPs/hostnames and strip token headers. we should call that out in the copy.
Priya: good call. propose copy: "Send anonymized diagnostics (no secrets) to Redwood Support". explicitness reduces surprise.
Devon: UX suggestion: place the send-diagnostics action behind a tiny confirmation modal summarizing what we're sending and a link to the privacy doc. one-line: "This will include network probe logs and config — no credentials."
Alan: accessibility nit: status chips use color + text. make sure we don't rely on color alone. e.g., "Success"/"Blocked" with aria-live announcements for the probe result. a11y-bot can confirm required attributes.
a11y-bot: suggested checklist: 1) status chips include aria-labels (e.g., aria-label="Probe result: Blocked - port 22"); 2) add role="status" + aria-live="polite" for the probe summary; 3) ensure contrast ratio for red error pill >= 4.5:1.
Sam: telemetry question again — do we log the full traceroute? legal may want summarized data only. i'll loop in privacy. for now let's plan to include only summarized hop counts + flags, not full IP lists.
Devon: copy tweaks i want to try: root message "We're checking network access to Redwood (this won't change your network)." detail line: "If you see 'Blocked', try opening port X or follow the troubleshooting steps." action label: `Quick recheck` and secondary `Run full diagnostic` (explain time estimates).
Priya: also debating whether to show a 'Why are we checking this?' inline tooltip for users new to on-prem. It would say: "We validate egress to our service endpoints to ensure model downloads and telemetry succeed"
Alan: prefer tooltip + a short link to a support article, rather than a modal that interrupts flow.
ops-bot: automated probe run 1778882250: result=BLOCKED target=redwood-inference-api:443 probe_type=tcp timeout_ms=5000 hops=3
Devon: thanks ops-bot — can we show ops-bot output under the 'More details' section in a monospace block? but collapse by default.
Priya: for the collapsed raw output, include an obvious 'Copy' button and a one-line expander label: 'Show raw probe output (for support)'.
Sam: one more: when probe fails and user hits 'Quick recheck', we should show an optimistic spinner and a toast that says 'Rechecking network — this usually takes <20s'. avoids confusion when nothing seems to happen.
Devon: UX micro-animation idea: a small inline timeline that transitions from 'checking → analyzing → summary' so users see progress without a huge modal.
Alan: mobile responsiveness note: the debug bundle and copy actions should be stacked, not side-by-side. small screens are common for SREs checking from phones.
Priya: acceptance criteria for eng: 1) implement quick vs full probe paths, 2) implement masked support bundle with confirmation modal, 3) provide aria-live region + status labels, 4) wire telemetry to only include summarized hops.
Devon: i'll update the figma and attach new component variants. leaving comments on the 'More details' section about the monospace block and copy button.
Sam: i'll draft the support-side doc describing what's in the bundle and share with privacy/legal.
Alan: final a11y check requested once implemented — particularly focus on screen-reader flow for progressive results.
Priya: thanks team. plan: dev review on tmrw sync, beta in staging next week. tagging @devon for final copy. :sparkles:
